name: Exage 400LX 7-speed shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 184 g for the explicitly paired SL-M453 seven-speed thumb controls. The unsuffixed model is retained separately from SL-M453-A; no suffix alias or single-side doubling is asserted.
